title: Hollow and Ember
author: Isandro Delacroix
blurb: Ansel Fairweather, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
